text:
Return eligibility depends on the product category.

Clothing may be returned within 15 calendar days after
delivery if unused and its tags are attached.

Electronics may be returned within seven calendar days
after delivery if unused.

Personal-care items are not returnable under this policy.

The delivery date is day zero. 
The final permitted day is included in the return window.

Clothing size exchanges follow the same eligibility
conditions as clothing returns.

An exchange depends on replacement stock availability.
The assistant cannot check live stock.

Products showing signs of use do not qualify for
standard return or exchange.

Customers must provide the order reference when submitting
an eligible return request.

Refund processing begins after the returned item is
received and inspected.

An eligibility result does not submit a return request
or guarantee a refund.

Manufacturing-defect claims follow a separate process
not covered by this assignment.
